WITH ym_2013 AS (
  SELECT
    ym.CustomerID,
    CAST(SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
    SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, CAST(SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
), cust_2013 AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    c.Currency,
    y.CustomerID,
    y.yr,
    y.total_consumption
  FROM ym_2013 y
  JOIN customers c
    ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE LOWER(c.Currency) = LOWER('CZK')
), min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    yr,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM cust_2013
  GROUP BY Segment, yr
), lowest_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    c.yr,
    c.CustomerID,
    c.total_consumption
  FROM cust_2013 c
  JOIN min_per_segment m
    ON m.Segment = c.Segment
   AND m.yr = c.yr
   AND m.min_consumption = c.total_consumption
), annual_avg_lowest AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    yr,
    SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM lowest_customers
  GROUP BY Segment, yr
), piv AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
  FROM annual_avg_lowest
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT
  yr AS year,
  (sme_avg - lam_avg) AS diff_sme_minus_lam,
  (lam_avg - kam_avg) AS diff_lam_minus_kam,
  (kam_avg - sme_avg) AS diff_kam_minus_sme
FROM piv
WHERE yr = 2013;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

WITH ym AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment AS Segment,
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Yr,
    SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE LOWER(c.Currency) = LOWER('EUR')
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012','2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
), seg AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Yr = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Yr = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
  FROM ym
  GROUP BY Segment
), pct AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    cons_2012,
    cons_2013,
    (cons_2013 - cons_2012) AS increase_or_decrease,
    CASE
      WHEN cons_2013 = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ((cons_2013 - cons_2012) / CAST(cons_2013 AS REAL)) * 100
    END AS pct_increase
  FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM (
  SELECT Segment, pct_increase, 1 AS ord
  FROM pct
  ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
  LIMIT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Segment, pct_increase, 2 AS ord
  FROM pct
  ORDER BY pct_increase ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY ord;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
